CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

4. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

8. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

9. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

12. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   D. Damage equipment used for Football.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
